title: every @New York City Center encores show I see I say is my favorite o...
transcript: Join me at the theater tonight I'm seeing the final dress rehearsal of Titanic at New York City Center everyone knows I am a New York City Center superfan but nothing prepared me for this one Titanic is the last show of Encores! 30th season. It’s running for the next two weeks and tonight was the invited dress. They threw a little party at Tanner Smiths. And we even got to hear from the director Anne Kauffman I'm kind of obsessed with her now. Before headingover to the theater these final dress rehearsals are so much fun, but I was shocked cause we were literally sitting in the front row like I have never been this close to the stage ever in my whole life and this cast is one of the best ever assembled so the idea that I would be this close to all of them was setting me into a tailspin we were also surrounded by members of the original cast and the creative team. I was losing it because Jonathan Tunick was behind us and the show was so good. There are 32 people in this cast and 30 members of the orchestra and it just sounds lush and I would like to remind you all that this is a concert production people use books it is a light set it's light choreography but none of that matters because the performances are so good Bonnie's Alice perfection and I honestly don't think I've ever cried harder in my life than when Chip and Judy sang ‘still’ together even just like the ensemble so good. Lady’s Maid amazing I posted the rehearsal video Sammie Williams Lilli Cooper Ashley Blanchet stars all of them like Brandon Uranowitz such a jerk in this but perfect at it. seeing this from the front row is an experience I will never forget but also I bought an access ticket for closing and I'm sitting literally like in the back row of the balcony and I cannot wait New York City Center never misses go see Titanic.
